title: Scully meets a scientist in the Mojave

tellings.quote: They met in the Mojave Desert with one of them and he starts to tell Frank this amazing story about a flying saucer recovery.

plain: Around 1949, a writer named Frank Scully is said to have met a scientist in the Mojave Desert who told him a remarkable story about the recovery of a crashed flying saucer. The men involved were named Silas Newton and Leo Gaybower, and Scully later wrote the story up in his book Behind the Flying Saucers. A researcher named Scott Ramsey tells it on the show as a summary, presenting it as one of the earliest accounts of a saucer being recovered.
